abilities.name: reckless
abilities.effect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

abilities.name: adaptability
abilities.effect: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

abilities.name: mold-breaker
abilities.effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

original-unova.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

updated-unova.flavorText: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.

kalos.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

updated-alola.flavorText: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That’s how violent Basculin are.

swsh.flavorText: In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it’s more popular with the youth.

pla.flavorText: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
